newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Credit slips in heavy trade.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Credit slips in heavy trade.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd shares fell slightly in early morning Monday trade, as some investors were still a little unsure if restructuring plans would really help the debt-ridden bank, brokers said.
As of 0040 GMT, the shares were nine yen lower at 280, with trade totalling 1.608 million shares, making it the most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo exchange.
"It is not as if there is anything new to bring on selling," a trader at a foreign brokerage said.
"Investors are wary of the issue, and also the effect of the overhaul plan on the banking sector in general is bad, so they are reluctant to believe that the problems are over."
Nippon Credit Bank is now in the final stage of working out a restructuring plan.
